This course, Advanced Database, introduces core concepts and applied methods in database management. Students examine PostgreSQL, data modeling, and entity relationship modeling through lectures, guided laboratories, case studies, and project-based assessment. Learning activities develop conceptual understanding, practical problem solving, technical communication, and responsible use of digital tools. By the end of the course, students can analyze requirements, design a solution, implement a working prototype, and evaluate results using ACID properties and MySQL. The syllabus includes structured practice with relational databases, normalization, and Oracle Database, supported by documentation and peer feedback. Assessment combines individual exercises, laboratory reports, quizzes, a team project, and a final presentation. Prerequisite knowledge includes basic computing, logical reasoning, and the ability to read technical documentation in Indonesian or English.
